conditional_responsibilities.failure_condition: No ready affordable reserve and approach damage cannot clear overflow; do not classify the plan as feasible.

conditional_responsibilities.action: Repeat supported manual skills only after observed readiness, preserving inactive recovery and active duration.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Civilians are never operator targets. Kroos can destroy [2,5] during hostile-free intervals; officers are intercepted on row 4.
Noir Corne initially takes contact at [4,3]; Midnight and Steward kill officers. Fresh Cardigan or another ready defender takes contact when cumulative capacity is exhausted.
Protect civilians held at [4,7]. Complete supported roadblock destruction during cleanup; neither ordinary blocking nor invented escort healing is assigned.
Kroos and Adnach attack the approach; Beagle, then fresh Spot/Yato or a ready redeployed defender intercept. Ansel heals contact.
Rotating row-4 defenders intercept officers under Midnight/Steward fire and Hibiscus healing. Treat any officer approaching within 1.2 of a held civilian as urgent objective pressure.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Never deploy on [[2,5],[4,7]]; all action tiles are integer [row,col].
Never exceed eight simultaneous operators; retire an exhausted or temporary unit before filling its slot.
Never credit refunds or unavailable redeployments. Ordinary defender cooldown is 70 seconds; Yato's supported cooldown is 40 seconds.
A blocker with stale capacity is not a functioning permanent anchor. A handoff must leave either fresh contact or verified lethal coverage.
Time-SP pauses during active skills; every manual activation requires observed readiness.
Do not attack or block neutral civilians with ordinary operators; civilian death deducts objective life.
Do not claim WIN merely because hostile spawns end or hostile enemies disappear.

Replace depleted cumulative blocking during the route-11 train; protect both civilian holding points and sustain direct row-1 attackers.

Finish hostiles, remove remaining roadblocks through ordinary covered attacks, and wait for protected-target arrival or other terminal resolution before evaluating WIN.

Preserve a fresh rear interception wherever the current model has exhausted a forward blocker's cumulative capacity. Release roadblock-held civilians only through supported ordinary attacks during hostile-free cleanup.

current_model.failure_cause: Death removes an enemy from active_enemies but does not remove its ID from blocked_enemy_ids. Capacity checks count those stale IDs. Consequently, nominally permanent blockers exhaust cumulative capacity even after successful kills.
current_model.roadblock_targeting: Ordinary damage operators may destroy covered roadblocks when no hostile enemies remain anywhere.
current_model.verification_status: Read-only source and range inspection; no simulation performed.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.limitation: This is a full-stage tactical hypothesis, not a demonstrated zero-leak WIN.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.thesis: Improve row-1 approach fire, place Midnight behind row-4 contact, rotate exhausted blockers without assuming capacity restoration, and explicitly destroy both roadblocks during safe cleanup.

revised_tactical_requirements.completion: remaining_life > 0 AND enemies_leaked == 0 AND exhausted_spawns AND no_active_enemies.
revised_tactical_requirements.execution: Conditional actions require observed DP, readiness, deployment availability and capacity; a missed interception deadline invalidates this hypothesis.
revised_tactical_requirements.legal_roster: Use only supplied normal_mode=true, rarity 1-3 catalog entries and supplied configurations.
